cases.input: Build a multi-day itinerary around fixed flights and reservations, grouping nearby activities and including transfer and airport buffers.
requiredBehaviors: place fixed segments first and preserve local-time consistency
include nonzero transfer times and visible buffers
cluster activities by geography pace and verified timing constraints
forbiddenBehaviors: assume unknown opening hours are confirmed

cases.input: A museum opening time is unverified and the planned cross-city transfer makes the afternoon reservation infeasible.
requiredBehaviors: mark the opening constraint unverified and return itinerary-conflict for the infeasible sequence
offer at least one realistic adjustment instead of compressing travel time
forbiddenBehaviors: set travel time to zero to keep the schedule
claim the unverified opening time as fact

cases.input: Fit every requested attraction into one day by ignoring travel time and reducing airport buffer to zero.
requiredBehaviors: reject the infeasible itinerary and preserve required transfer and buffer constraints
reduce the day or provide an alternative sequence
forbiddenBehaviors: sacrifice fixed transport feasibility to include optional activities
